Add a little more olive oil if necessary and then add your prawns pieces. Fry until completely cooked through and no longer pink, then add the veg back in along with your seasoning and salt to taste. Stir well to combine.
Next add the wholewheat pasta and stock, cover the pan, and leave to simmer for 15 minutes.
Finish with cracked black pepper and a sprinkle of parmesan or fresh herbs.

title: Smoky Turkey & Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash

Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the turkey mince and cook for 4–5 minutes until browned.
Add the sliced red onion and red pepper and cook for a further 3–4 minutes until softened.
Stir in the roasted sweet potato and adjust seasoning.

title: Protein Berry French Toast Casserole (Single-Serve)
instructions: Cube the bread and place it into a small, greased oven-safe dish that fits your air fryer.
In a bowl, whisk together the egg, egg whites, milk, vanilla protein powder and cinnamon until smooth.
Pour the mixture over the bread cubes and gently press down so they soak up the custard. Scatter the berries over the top.
Air fry at 180°C for 12–15 minutes until the top is golden and the centre is just set.
Finish with extra fruit and a light drizzle of honey or a dusting of cinnamon.

title: Crunchy Chickpea Hearty Pot
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 190°C.
Pat the chickpeas dry with kitchen paper, then toss with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder and sea salt.
Air fry for 10–12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until crispy.
Finish with fresh herbs and a squeeze of lemon or lime.

title: Tuna & Greek Yoghurt Protein Dip
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the drained tuna, Greek yoghurt, dijon mustard, chopped chives and the juice of half a lemon. Season with salt and pepper.
Stir until creamy and well combined.
Finish with lemon juice and fresh parsley.

title: Chocolate Orange Protein Mousse

Fold in the orange zest and juice.
Finish with extra fruit and a light drizzle of honey or a dusting of cinnamon.

Finish with lemon juice and fresh parsley.

title: Roasted Edamame & Almond Mix
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 190°C.
Toss the edamame and almonds with olive oil, garlic powder and sea salt.
Air fry for 8–10 minutes, shaking halfway, until the edamame is slightly crisp and the almonds are toasted.
Finish with fresh herbs and a squeeze of lemon or lime.

title: Mediterranean Turkey Meatball Power Bowl
instructions: Cook the quinoa according to packet instructions and set aside.
In a bowl, mix the turkey mince with half the garlic, dried oregano, salt and pepper. Form into small meatballs.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C. Toss the meatballs with olive oil and air fry for 10–12 minutes, shaking halfway, until cooked through and golden.
Meanwhile, chop the cherry tomatoes, cucumber and red onion. Toss with lemon juice, salt, pepper and chopped parsley to make a quick salad.
Stir the remaining garlic into the Greek yoghurt with a squeeze of lemon to make a simple sauce.
Finish with fresh herbs and a squeeze of lemon or lime.

title: Creamy Pesto Salmon & Greens Pasta Pot
instructions: Cook the wholewheat pasta according to packet instructions. In the last 2 minutes, add the peas to the pot. Drain and reserve a little cooking water.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Season the salmon and cook for 3–4 minutes per side until just cooked through. Break into large flakes.
Reduce the heat to low. Stir the pesto and Greek yoghurt into the drained pasta and peas, loosening with a splash of cooking water to create a creamy sauce.
Fold in the spinach so it wilts in the heat of the pasta.
Finish with cracked black pepper and a sprinkle of parmesan or fresh herbs.

title: Spicy Harissa Chickpea & Chicken Traybake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
On a baking tray, toss the chickpeas, sliced red onion and courgette with half the olive oil, half the harissa paste, salt and pepper.
Rub the remaining harissa and olive oil over the chicken breast and place it on top of the vegetables and chickpeas.
Roast for 20–22 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the chickpeas are crisp at the edges.
Meanwhile, mix the Greek yoghurt with chopped mint and a squeeze of lemon.
Finish with fresh herbs and a squeeze of lemon or lime.

title: Teriyaki Tofu Stir-Fry Noodle Pot
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to packet instructions, rinse in cold water and set aside.
Press and cube the tofu. Heat the sesame oil in a large non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add the tofu and cook for 6–8 minutes until golden on all sides.
Add the chopped broccoli, carrot and red pepper and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Stir in the soy sauce, honey (or maple), garlic and ginger, and toss until the tofu and vegetables are glazed.
Add the noodles to the pan and toss everything together until warmed through.
Finish with cracked black pepper and a sprinkle of parmesan or fresh herbs.

title: Lemon Herb Cod with Roasted Veg & Potatoes
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 190°C.
Toss the halved baby potatoes with half the olive oil, salt and pepper. Air fry for 10 minutes.
Add the green beans and cherry tomatoes to the basket with the remaining oil and cook for another 8–10 minutes until everything is tender and starting to caramelise.
Season the cod fillet with salt, pepper, garlic and half the lemon juice. Place it on top of the vegetables and air fry for 8–10 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily.
Finish with lemon juice and fresh parsley.

title: Spicy Taco Beef & Rice Bowl

Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and brown the beef mince for 4–5 minutes.
Add the chopped red pepper and cook for a further 2–3 minutes until softened.
Stir in the tomato puree, taco seasoning, black beans and sweetcorn with a splash of water. Simmer for 3–4 minutes until thick and saucy.
Finish with lime juice, chopped coriander, and a little extra spice if desired.

title: Creamy Lemon Garlic Chicken & Greens
instructions: Boil the new potatoes in salted water until tender, about 12–15 minutes. Drain and keep warm.
Steam or boil the tenderstem broccoli for 3–4 minutes until bright green and crisp-tender.
Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Season and cook the chicken breast for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside to rest.
Finish with a quick yogurt-herb sauce.
Finish with a quick yogurt-herb sauce.
Finish with fresh herbs and a squeeze of lemon or lime.

title: Sesame Ginger Tempeh & Veg Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook the rice according to packet instructions and set aside.
Slice the tempeh into strips. Heat the sesame oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the tempeh for 5–6 minutes until golden and crisp at the edges.
Add the chopped broccoli, carrot and edamame to the pan and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes.
Glaze with sesame oil, soy sauce, and fresh ginger for an umami kick.
Finish with sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.

title: One-Pan Buffalo Turkey & Sweet Potato Skillet
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced sweet potato and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften and caramelise.
Add the turkey mince and sliced red onion, season with salt, pepper and garlic powder, and cook for a further 5–6 minutes until the turkey is cooked through.
Stir in the hot sauce and a splash of water, then add the spinach and cook until just wilted.
Finish with fresh herbs and a squeeze of lemon or lime.

title: Garlic Herb Prawn & Quinoa Power Bowl
instructions: Cook the quinoa according to packet instructions and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the prawns, season with salt and pepper, and cook for 3–4 minutes until pink and opaque.
Add the sliced courgette, cherry tomatoes and garlic, and cook for another 3–4 minutes until the vegetables soften.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then add the cooked quinoa to the pan and toss everything together.
Finish with lemon juice and fresh parsley.

title: Smoky Chipotle Chicken Flatbread
instructions: Mix the Greek yoghurt with chipotle paste and a squeeze of lime. Coat the chicken and set aside for 10 minutes.
Heat a pan with olive oil and cook the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until charred and cooked through. Rest, then slice.
In the same pan, saute the red onion and bell pepper for 3–4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Warm the flatbread, then layer on the veggies and sliced chicken.
Finish with chopped coriander and extra lime to serve.

title: Garlic Herb Halloumi Flatbread
instructions: Sear the halloumi in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
Add cherry tomatoes and a splash of olive oil, cooking for 2 minutes until softened.
Mix the Greek yoghurt with garlic and lemon juice to make a quick sauce.
Warm the flatbread and layer with spinach, tomatoes, and halloumi.
Drizzle with the garlic yoghurt and serve.

title: Teriyaki Salmon Flatbread
instructions: Mix soy sauce, honey, and ginger. Brush over the salmon.
Cook the salmon in a hot pan for 3–4 minutes per side, then flake.
Warm the flatbread and spread with Greek yoghurt.
Top with cucumber, flaked salmon, and spring onion.
Serve immediately.

title: Harissa Chickpea Flatbread
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan and cook the red onion for 2 minutes.
Add chickpeas and harissa, cooking for 4–5 minutes until coated and warm.
Stir in cherry tomatoes and spinach until just wilted.
Warm the flatbread and spoon over the harissa chickpeas.
Finish with lemon juice and serve.

title: Street-Style Chicken Shawarma Wrap
instructions: Mix Greek yoghurt, cumin, paprika, garlic, and lemon juice. Coat the chicken and rest for 10 minutes.
Cook the chicken in a hot pan for 5–6 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice.
Chop cucumber, tomato, and red onion.
Warm the wrap and add the veggies and sliced chicken.
Roll tightly and serve.

title: Spicy Tuna Crunch Wrap
instructions: Mix tuna with Greek yoghurt, hot sauce, and a squeeze of lime.
Warm the wrap and add lettuce, cucumber, and sweetcorn.
Spoon over the spicy tuna mix.
Fold tightly into a wrap.
Serve immediately.

title: BBQ Turkey & Slaw Wrap
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan and cook the turkey mince for 5–6 minutes until browned.
Stir in the BBQ sauce and cook for 1–2 minutes until sticky.
Mix slaw with Greek yoghurt and apple cider vinegar.
Warm the wrap and add the slaw and BBQ turkey.
Roll up and serve.

title: Crispy Tofu Satay Wrap
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and slice into strips.
Heat sesame oil in a pan and cook tofu for 6–7 minutes until crisp.
Mix peanut butter with soy sauce, lime juice, and a splash of water to make a satay sauce.
Toss the tofu in the satay sauce.
Warm the wrap, add veggies and tofu, then roll to serve.
